results.question: What is our overall gross profit margin?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum((l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount) / 1.1 - v.cost * l.quantity)::numeric, 2) AS gross_profit, round(sum((l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount) / 1.1)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue_ex_gst, round((sum((l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount) / 1.1 - v.cost * l.quantity) / nullif(sum((l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount) / 1.1), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS gross_profit_margin_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN variants v ON l.variant_id = v.variant_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND v.cost IS NOT NULL
results.answer: Your overall gross profit margin across all time is 58.32%, based on a gross profit of $1,584,502.69 and a net revenue of $2,716,823.41 (excluding GST and after discounts). This calculation assumes any items with missing cost data were excluded from the profit figures.

results.question: What are our top 5 products by gross profit?

This covers data from October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026. Please note that products without cost information and custom sales products were excluded from these figures.
results.assumptions: Data covers 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (treated as today). Gross profit is calculated as (line revenue ex-GST) minus (unit cost * quantity). Variants with NULL cost are excluded, and custom sales products are excluded.

results.question: Which product has had the most units refunded, and how many?
results.sql: SELECT p.title AS product_title, sum(rl.quantity) AS units_refunded FROM refund_lines rl JOIN order_lines ol ON rl.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.title ORDER BY units_refunded DESC LIMIT 1
results.answer: The product with the most units refunded across the entire data period is the One-Piece Swimsuit, with 165 units refunded. This counts actual physical units returned from non-voided orders and excludes custom-status products.
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: Which product has had the most units refunded across the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30), excluding voided orders? Products marked with status 'custom' are excluded.

results.question: How many different customers have placed an order?
results.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS number_of_customers FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
results.answer: A total of 2,909 unique identified customers have placed at least one non-voided order across all time. This total only counts tracked customers and excludes any guest checkouts where no customer ID was recorded.
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: How many unique identified customers have placed at least one non-voided order across all time (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30). Guest checkouts (customer_id IS NULL) are excluded since they do not represent distinct tracked customers.

results.question: What percentage of orders were placed by guests with no customer account?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS guest_order_percentage, SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guest_orders_count, COUNT(*) AS total_orders_count FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided';
results.answer: Guests with no customer account placed 22.47% of your orders. This accounts for 3,896 guest orders out of a total of 17,340 non-voided orders. This calculation includes all non-voided orders recorded across the entire data period from October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026.
results.assumptions: Calculated across all non-voided orders from the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30).

results.question: What was our revenue in each of the last 3 months?
results.sql: SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney', 'YYYY-MM') AS month, round(sum(total)::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' >= (date_trunc('month', '2026-09-30'::date AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') - interval '2 months') AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' < (date_trunc('month', '2026-09-30'::date AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') + interval '1 month') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
results.answer: Your revenue for the last three months was $342,251.10 in July, $282,129.97 in August, and $278,068.87 in September 2026. These figures represent gross order totals and exclude any voided orders through the end of September 2026.
results.assumptions: Data period ends 30 September 2026. Last 3 months are July, August, and September 2026. Revenue is gross order totals excluding voided orders.

results.question: How did revenue during the EOFY sale (19 June to 5 July 2026) compare to the same number of days immediately before it?
results.sql:
WITH eofy_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    'EOFY Sale (19 Jun - 5 Jul)' AS period,
    sum(total) AS gross_revenue,
    count(order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE financial_status <> 'voided'
    AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-19 00:00:00'
    AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-06 00:00:00'
),
before_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    'Pre-EOFY (2 Jun - 18 Jun)' AS period,
    sum(total) AS gross_revenue,
    count(order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE financial_status <> 'voided'
    AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-02 00:00:00'
    AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-19 00:00:00'
)
SELECT * FROM eofy_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM before_sales;
results.answer: Revenue jumped during the EOFY sale, bringing in $246,002.91 across 1,240 orders compared to $186,171.83 from 794 orders in the 17 days right before it. This comparison assumes that the 17-day pre-EOFY period is a fair baseline for your usual sales pace.
results.assumptions: Compared the 17-day EOFY sale period (19 June to 5 July 2026) to the immediately preceding 17-day period (2 June to 18 June 2026). Revenue is gross revenue (non-voided orders.total).

results.question: Which 3 products have sold the fewest units?
results.sql: SELECT p.title AS product_title, sum(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN variants v USING (product_id) JOIN order_lines l USING (variant_id) JOIN orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND p.status <> 'custom' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.title ORDER BY units_sold ASC LIMIT 3
results.answer: The products that have sold the fewest units all-time are the Rash Vest with 221 units, the Maxi Dress with 232 units, and the Knit Midi Dress with 253 units. This covers the entire data period from October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026. Custom sales and voided orders were excluded from these figures.
results.assumptions: Interpreting as all-time units sold per product (excluding custom sales and voided orders) across the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30).

results.question: How many customers have placed 3 or more orders?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(DISTINCT order_id) >= 3) t
results.answer: You have 1,640 unique identified customers who have placed 3 or more non-voided orders. This count is based on the entire data period from 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 and excludes guest checkouts where no customer ID was recorded.
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: How many unique identified customers have placed 3 or more non-voided orders across the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30)? Guest checkouts (customer_id IS NULL) are excluded.

results.question: On average, how many days after the order are refunds issued?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.created_at - o.created_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS average_days_to_refund FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
results.answer: On average, refunds are issued 18.5 days after an order is placed. This result assumes all refunds in the dataset include complete and accurate creation dates for both the original order and the subsequent refund.
results.assumptions: Calculated the average number of days between order creation and refund creation across all refund events in the dataset.

results.question: How much revenue came from orders that used a discount?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(total)::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND discount_id IS NOT NULL;
results.answer: You brought in $944,363.46 in gross revenue from orders that used a discount across the entire data period. This total includes all non-voided orders that applied any type of promotional discount between 2025-10-01 and 2026-09-30.

results.question: Which colour sold the most units in winter (June to August 2026), and how many?
results.sql: SELECT v.color, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_lines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id JOIN variants v ON l.variant_id = v.variant_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND v.color IS NOT NULL AND (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY v.color ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1;
results.answer: Camel sold the most units in winter 2026 with a total of 1,050 units sold. This result is based on sales recorded between June 1, 2026, and August 31, 2026, while excluding voided orders and variants without a recorded colour.
results.assumptions: Winter 2026 defined as June 1, 2026 to August 31, 2026 in Australia/Sydney time. Excluded voided orders and variants without a recorded colour.

results.question: Compare weekend revenue with weekday revenue.
results.sql:
WITH order_days AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    total,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') IN (6, 7) THEN 'Weekend'
      ELSE 'Weekday'
    END AS day_type
  FROM orders
  WHERE financial_status <> 'voided'
)
SELECT 
  day_type AS day_type,
  COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS gross_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM order_days
GROUP BY day_type
ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC;
results.answer: Weekdays brought in more total revenue than weekends between October 2025 and September 2026. Weekdays generated $2,147,980.22 across 11,153 orders, while weekends brought in $1,173,950.49 across 6,187 orders. This comparison is based on all available data in that period using local Sydney time, excluding voided orders.
results.assumptions: Comparing weekend (Saturday and Sunday) versus weekday (Monday to Friday) gross revenue across all available data (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30), using Australia/Sydney local time to determine the days of the week. Voided orders are excluded.

results.question: What is the best-selling product in each product type?
results.sql:
WITH ranked_products AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_type,
    p.title AS product_title,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS units_sold,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(p.product_type) ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity) DESC) AS rn
  FROM products p
  JOIN variants v ON p.product_id = v.product_id
  JOIN order_lines ol ON v.variant_id = ol.variant_id
  JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided'
    AND p.status <> 'custom'
  GROUP BY p.product_type, p.title
)
SELECT 
  product_type,
  product_title,
  units_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_type;
results.answer: Your best-selling product for each type, measured by total units sold across non-voided orders from October 2025 through September 2026, is led by Swimwear with the One-Piece Swimsuit at 4,043 units, Accessories with the Straw Hat at 3,619 units, and Skirts with the Linen Wrap Skirt at 1,804 units. Other top sellers include the Shirt Dress at 1,492 units for Dresses, the Ribbed Tank at 1,395 units for Tops, High-Rise Jeans at 1,295 units for Pants, the Wool Coat at 828 units for Outerwear, and the Merino Crew Jumper at 526 units for Knitwear. Custom sales were excluded from this all-time data.
results.assumptions: Interpreting all-time data (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30). Best-selling is measured by total units sold across non-voided orders. Custom sales are excluded.

results.question: How many orders contained more than one unit in total?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING sum(l.quantity) > 1) t
results.answer: You had 8,908 orders that contained more than one unit in total. This count covers valid orders from October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026, and excludes any voided transactions.
results.assumptions: Data covers 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. Excluded voided orders. Counted orders where the sum of quantities across all order lines is strictly greater than one.

results.question: For each store location show the number of orders, units sold and revenue
results.sql: WITH order_stats AS ( SELECT l.location_id, l.name AS location_name, count(o.order_id) AS order_count, sum(o.total) AS gross_revenue FROM locations l JOIN orders o ON l.location_id = o.location_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY l.location_id, l.name ), line_stats AS ( SELECT l.location_id, sum(ol.quantity) AS units_sold FROM locations l JOIN orders o ON l.location_id = o.location_id JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY l.location_id ) SELECT os.location_name, os.order_count, ls.units_sold, os.gross_revenue FROM order_stats os JOIN line_stats ls USING (location_id) ORDER BY os.gross_revenue DESC
results.answer: Here is the breakdown of your sales by store location for the period from October 2025 to September 2026. The Online Store led with 10,667 orders, 20,372 units sold, and $2,070,833.88 in gross revenue. Surry Hills Boutique followed with 4,036 orders, 7,533 units sold, and $755,981.28 in revenue. Newtown Boutique recorded 2,637 orders, 4,966 units sold, and $495,115.55 in revenue. These figures represent gross revenue excluding voided orders.
results.assumptions: Data covers 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (all time in dataset). Revenue is gross revenue (orders.total) excluding voided orders, computed separately from unit counts to avoid duplication.
